country.name: United Arab Emirates

default_in_force_rule.text: Constitution art. 111: federal laws are published in the Official Gazette within two weeks of signature and come into force one month after publication unless the law provides otherwise. Each act's own in-force clause overrides this.

country.licence_note: Text: UAE Legislation platform (uaelegislation.gov.ae), UAE Cabinet; read from Internet Archive captures. In case of conflict the Arabic text prevails.

sources.name: UAE Legislation, Arabic act page for the Constitution (id 1000), Internet Archive capture 20250529114023
sources.licence: Official text of the UAE federal government; no reuse licence stated on the site.
sources.notes: The live site answers this machine with a Cloudflare challenge (403), so only archive.org id_ captures are read.

versions.note: Consolidated Arabic text as published by uaelegislation.gov.ae, which states it is current to its last update of 29 March 2023. Earlier wordings are not yet added.

decisions: Interim build: the Constitution is one "oldest version available" version (first_law null), dated 2023-03-29, the date the publisher gives for its last update, and credited to the publisher.
Arabic is the authoritative text and is what is built; the English version on the same site is a reference only.
Part and chapter headings are not yet kept as units; the preamble (loaded by the site via ajax) is not yet included.
ai_use: none: no model wrote, summarised or corrected any legal text; parsing is rule-based (parse.py).
